Triage: lands in `area:build` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p1` · Bug · `pm:dispatched` (claim untouched) · size S; type set to Bug (was none).
Rationale: two case-only filename pairs under `ui/packages/app-shell/src` make the Console bundle fail on case-insensitive file systems (macOS), so a local environment cannot start there. That is the builder's road broken with no workaround on a common developer platform ⇒ p1, the same mechanism as #36589, which closed without its guard. The card's item 2 (a check) reads as the recurrence fix for that same card, not a new gate.
